packageRules.description: Group non-major toolchain bumps (dotnet SDK base, Node major, Claude Code CLI) into one PR so the fat image rebuilds once and the SBOM records a coherent toolchain. The pins are annotated in src/build/pr-bot/Dockerfile: the built-in dockerfile manager reads the FROM line, and the custom manager below reads the ARG lines.
Keep major toolchain bumps (for example dotnet SDK 10 -> 11 or Node 20 -> 24) in their own PR so a breaking runtime change is reviewed and canaried in isolation from routine patches.

customManagers.description: Build-arg toolchain pins in the harness Dockerfile. The built-in dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, so NODE_MAJOR and CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION need an explicit manager driven by '# renovate:' annotations. NODE_MAJOR keeps a bare-major format (the NodeSource apt repo URL requires it) via versioning=node.
